column1: # SO DO LO — moi lo mot dong, ghi NGAY sau khi soat xong, truoc khi commit.
# Cau hoi can tra loi (chot 29/07/2026): so luong loi noi dung tu bat duoc co
# GIAM khi lo to len khong? Neu co thi tran cong lo phai ha, vi cua may KHONG
# kiem noi dung — xem git log quanh 29/07 muc "p/p cua co lo".
# Vi sao phai ghi tay: `soat`/`dodai` do duoc px va o do, nhung "so loi tu bat"
# thi khong may nao dem duoc — no nam trong bao cao cua agent. Bo trong = khong
# ro, KHAC voi 0 = da ra soat ky ma khong thay loi nao.
# docbangmat    so muc trong danh sach "PHAI DOC BANG MAT" cua `soat`
# loitubat      loi NOI DUNG agent tu doc lai roi tu sua (khong cua may nao bat)
# loimaybat     loi do cua `soat`/`dodai` bat (cau truc, trong am lech, qua tran)
# nguonsai      lan agent BAC du lieu tu dien sai thay vi chep theo
# odotb         so o do trung binh, tu `dodai`
